name: Dragonboat
description:
Dragonboat is the OS for the Agentic Product Enterprise: a single living system where executives, teams, and AI agents reason, decide, act, and adapt from the same operating context, from strategy through execution to outcomes. Built on a live ontology foundation, it keeps context, intent, and memory current as fast as your enterprise moves.

With the Dragonboat connector for Claude, users can search, create, update, and scenario-plan operating objects, including strategy, intake, investment, and roadmap/work items, directly from Claude:

- Capture unstructured input (meeting notes, customer insights, updates) and map it into structured operating semantics, keeping the source of truth live

- Find any operating data on demand, including goals, insights, investments, work items, and change history, and generate decks or reports

- Enrich and update operating objects in context, or trigger updates across other tools for multi-agent collaboration

- Run scenario plans and surface ripple effects across dependencies before committing changes

Note: Requires an active Dragonboat account with the MCP Server enabled. Contact help@dragonboat.io or your CSM.

Security & Compliance: SOC2 Type 2 certified, ISO 27001 compliant. Data encrypted at rest and in transit. Zero Data Retention agreement with AI provider (Azure OpenAI Enterprise) — no customer data stored or used for training.

Use cases

Search — "Show me all initiatives that are at risk." Returns at-risk items with owners and health status.

Create intake — "Create intake from this meeting note and assign to me." Parses notes into structured intake items.

Agentic workflow — "Find Q2 2026 portfolio items for the Platform team and create a slide deck." Filters data and hands off to generate a presentation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dragonboat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dragonboat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://demo.dragonboat.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dragonboat MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dragonboat lists 32 MCP tools, including create_capability, create_customer_request, create_entity_comment, create_objective, create_portfolio_item, create_solution_request, get_custom_fields, get_org_integrations, get_portfolio_item_integrations, get_portfolio_item_pdlc_deliverables, get_system_field_names, and link_portfolio_item_to_integration.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dragonboat?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dragonboat in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Dragonboat requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dragonboat is developed by Dragonboat. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
